## Codex execution contract

**CGS-17 QA evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional and disclose when unavailable. A native delegate must actually run to be independent; otherwise use an explicitly labelled in-session fallback. Prior user authorization and host permissions govern all writes. Preserve the selected 30m, 1h, 2h or 4h protocol and its real timed checkpoints. A planned or shortened soak is not an executed full-duration pass; missing checkpoints are NOT ASSESSED. Do not claim an observer, build or measurements that did not exist.
